查看已有色散、离散 q 点及所附本征矢。: Inspect supplied dispersions, discrete q points, and accompanying eigenvectors.
仅有分段信息才连接为路径；此入口读取已有频率，不求解力常数。: Only segmentation information establishes connected paths. This tool reads existing frequencies and does not solve force constants.
检查结构，或为已给定的本征矢补充原胞结构。: Inspect a structure, or supply a companion primitive-cell structure for existing eigenvectors.
没有频率记录时只显示结构；位移与力文件本身不会生成声子谱。: Without frequency records, only the structure is displayed. Displacement and force files alone do not generate a phonon spectrum.
查看已有总声子态密度。: Inspect a supplied total phonon density of states.
此处显示输入的总 DOS；热力学积分另需完整态数和归一化。: This view displays the supplied total DOS. Thermodynamic integration additionally requires complete mode counts and normalization.
查看逐原子或已声明分量的投影声子态密度。: Inspect projected phonon densities of states by atom or by declared component.
须选择投影 DOS 类型并匹配原胞原子；投影列不能冒充完整总 DOS。: Select the projected DOS type and match the primitive-cell atoms. Projected columns cannot substitute for a complete total DOS.
分类 Γ 点不变频率子空间，或将指定本征模冻结为结构。: Classify invariant Gamma-point frequency subspaces, or freeze a selected eigenmode into a structure.
冻结需要匹配的结构、质量、本征矢和相容超胞；只有频率的文件不够。: Freezing requires matching structure, masses, eigenvectors, and a compatible supercell. A frequency-only file is insufficient.
用带权布里渊区网格计算谐性自由能、熵和热容。: Calculate harmonic free energy, entropy, and heat capacity from a weighted Brillouin-zone mesh.
需要三维网格、完整 3N 模式、整数权重及频率单位；高对称路径和任意 q 点不能: A three-dimensional mesh, complete 3N modes, integer weights, and frequency units are required. High-symmetry paths and arbitrary q points cannot replace a bulk integration mesh.
导入已经计算的温度、自由能、熵和热容表。: Import an already calculated table of temperature, free energy, entropy, and heat capacity.
按文件声明的晶胞和单位读取；导入不验证产生该表的网格收敛或声子稳定性。: Read the cell and units declared in the file. Import does not verify the generating mesh's convergence or phonon stability.
对完整总声子态密度作谐性热力学积分。: Integrate a complete total phonon density of states for harmonic thermodynamics.
需要明确总 DOS 完整性、原子数、频率单位和归一化；投影或部分 DOS 不能替: Declare total-DOS completeness, atom count, frequency units, and normalization. Projected or partial DOS cannot replace a complete total DOS.
将多个体积对应的热性质表与静态能配对，开展准谐计算。: Pair thermal-property tables at multiple volumes with static energies for a quasiharmonic calculation.
每个体积都要一份完整热性质表，顺序须匹配体积和静态能；单独一份文件不是完整 QH: Each volume requires one complete thermal-property table in the same order as the volumes and static energies. A single file is not a complete QHA input.
输入工具名称、文件名、问题或群编号: Enter a tool name, filename, question, or group number
